execution_note: The successful experiment was executed as an inline PowerShell here-string piped to node --import tsx --input-type=module -. This saved script preserves that experiment, with its harness import adjusted for the saved file location and formatting expanded. The saved script has not been rerun.

initial_attempt.failure: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Expected values to be strictly equal: 0 !== 2
initial_attempt.configuration_gap: The initial probe used the harness default both tool presentation rather than the production executor's explicit native presentation; it also omitted the explicit maxTokens setting.
initial_attempt.correction: The follow-up diagnostic and successful two-turn probe set ctx.tools.presentAs('native') and maxTokens: 1000, matching the relevant production executor configuration.
initial_attempt.interpretation: The initial failure was a probe setup failure, not evidence that child reuse is unsupported. The initial host error event was not captured, so this record does not claim a separately isolated single-cause diagnosis.

diagnostic_attempt.purpose: Confirm that the corrected host configuration reaches the scripted model before repeating the original two-turn probe.

proves: A caller-owned AgentHandle from the installed DSH agents.create API can drive two sequential followup turns on the same live child.
Agent-scoped tool registration remains available across those turns.
The second model request includes both task prompts, so context accumulates.
Disposal removes the child from the live Agent registry.
does_not_prove: Real provider latency, throughput, cost, or output quality improvements.
End-to-end book build executor connection reuse or new-handoff acceptance.
An in-place history reset API or automatic context compaction.
Execution of the registered probe tool by the model; this probe checks registration lifetime.
